records.text: Andrew Kolvet once called Candace Owens before AmericaFest and seriously asked whether she was a witch.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Andrew called me up and he asked me, asked me, and I am not kidding, in earnest, he asked me, “Are you a witch?”

verification.notes: This concerns an alleged private telephone call. The episode documents Owens’s account, but no recording or independent participant confirmation is available.

sources.title: American Horror Story: Charlie Kirk’s “Shining” Disciples. | Candace Ep 288
